annotations.title: ERC-20 token approval check on Base

description: Check how much of a wallet's ERC-20 token a spender contract is approved to move on Base: the raw and formatted allowance, the token symbol and decimals, and whether the approval is unlimited. Use before a swap or deposit to see if an approve transaction is needed, and to audit a wallet for risky unlimited approvals. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

owner.description: Wallet address that holds the token (0x...)

spender.description: Address allowed to spend, usually a router or protocol contract (0x...)

token.description: ERC-20 token contract address on Base (0x...)
